physical.notes: Factory parts and final wiring; beam rest and ball occupancy are separate from matrix rest polarity. Spatial limitation: The factory PDF 62 leader places the tilt assembly below the left apron. No corresponding retained VPX contact object exists, and no manual-to-table frame fit is established; do not use an apron balloon as a coordinate.

Factory parts and final wiring; beam rest and ball occupancy are separate from matrix rest polarity. Spatial limitation: Drain is an invisible ball-destruction/stack-transfer object. It is not an independently modeled outhole microswitch; the stack reports address 10 logically and no fitted-contact coordinate can be derived from that callback.

Factory parts and final wiring; beam rest and ball occupancy are separate from matrix rest polarity. Spatial limitation: The cvpmBallStack synthesizes trough occupancy with no individual trough-contact objects. BallRelease is the shooter transfer kicker, not the right storage microswitch; the factory below-apron drawing has no proven table frame fit.

Factory parts and final wiring; beam rest and ball occupancy are separate from matrix rest polarity. Spatial limitation: The cvpmBallStack synthesizes trough occupancy with no individual trough-contact objects. BallRelease does not locate the left storage microswitch; the factory below-apron drawing has no proven table frame fit.
